title: No "Can't": From the Classroom to Faith
description: Steven explains why his Beijing first-year students struggle to drop informal high-school English in academic writing, and describes an IELTS speaking practice session that turned into a real breakthrough. He also weighs whether an online Chinese degree is worth $5,000 and reflects on faith as Adam Curry leaves No Agenda.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Episode Overview

sentences.zh: 今天这期节目从课堂聊到了心灵。
sentences.en: Today's episode goes from the classroom all the way to the soul.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文先谈学术英语：大一新生为什么总改不掉高中时学的口语化表达？
sentences.en: Steven starts with academic English: why do college freshmen keep failing to shake off the colloquial expressions they learned in high school?

sentences.zh: 接着讲了一次雅思口语练习，意外成了一次真正的突破。
sentences.en: Next he talks about an IELTS speaking practice session that unexpectedly turned into a real breakthrough.

sentences.zh: 他还在琢磨，读一个中文在线学位到底值不值。
sentences.en: He's also mulling over whether an online degree in Chinese is really worth it.

sentences.zh: 最后聊到亚当·库里离开《No Agenda》，以及最近“上帝”这个话题为什么总冒出来。
sentences.en: Finally, he talks about Adam Curry leaving "No Agenda," and why the topic of "God" keeps coming up lately.

sentences.zh: 整期节目里，他的蒜香黄油牛排一直在烤箱里烤着。
sentences.en: Throughout the whole episode, his garlic butter steak was roasting in the oven.

sentences.zh: 学术英语：为什么不能写 can't？
sentences.en: Academic English: why can't you write "can't"?

sentences.zh: 史蒂文在北京教中国学生英语，班上全是中国学生，也就是所谓的“单语课堂”。
sentences.en: Steven teaches English to Chinese students in Beijing; his class is made up entirely of Chinese students, which is what's called a "monolingual classroom."

sentences.zh: 今天的课件讲学术英语，他坦言这些规则有时“说实话，挺奇怪的”。
sentences.en: Today's lesson slides are about academic English, and he admits that these rules are sometimes, "to be honest, pretty strange."

sentences.zh: 学生问：为什么论文里不能用 can't、won't 这样的缩略形式？
sentences.en: A student asks: why can't you use contractions like can't and won't in a paper?

sentences.zh: 他的回答是，学术写作正式、客观、礼貌又专业，而缩略形式太口语。
sentences.en: His answer is that academic writing is formal, objective, polite and professional, while contractions are too colloquial.

sentences.zh: 他还指出几个用得太滥的“中式英语”：
sentences.en: He also points out a few overused bits of "Chinglish":

sentences.zh: What's more
sentences.en: What's more

sentences.zh: In my opinion
sentences.en: In my opinion

sentences.zh: As we all know
sentences.en: As we all know

sentences.zh: 这些学生刚走出高中几个月，高中老师曾把“好英语”讲得滴水不漏，如今外教却说那是错的。
sentences.en: These students left high school only a few months ago, where their teachers explained "good English" as if it were airtight, and now a foreign teacher is telling them it's wrong.

sentences.zh: 他们想写得专业些，文章却显得生硬。
sentences.en: They want to write more professionally, but their essays come across as stiff.

sentences.zh: 从第一人称到第三人称
sentences.en: From First Person to Third Person

sentences.zh: 周五，学生针对两篇文章（一篇讲化石燃料，一篇讲风能）写了第一人称的评论。
sentences.en: On Friday, the student wrote first-person commentaries on two articles (one about fossil fuels, one about wind energy).

sentences.zh: 今天史蒂文打算把它们改成第三人称的学术写作。
sentences.en: Today Steven plans to turn them into third-person academic writing.

sentences.zh: 学生却问：好好的第一人称评论，为什么非要改？
sentences.en: But the student asked: why do perfectly good first-person commentaries have to be changed?

sentences.zh: “问得好。我……我还真不知道答案。”
sentences.en: "Good question. I... I honestly don't know the answer."

sentences.zh: 史蒂文承认。
sentences.en: Steven admitted.

sentences.zh: 学生又说学术写作“听起来更专业”，于是大家讨论起什么才叫“专业”。
sentences.en: The student also said academic writing "sounds more professional," so they started discussing what actually counts as "professional."

sentences.zh: 对比两段文字时，正式与非正式一眼就能分辨，专业术语和平实语言却没那么容易区分。
sentences.en: When comparing two passages, formal and informal can be told apart at a glance, but technical jargon and plain language aren't so easy to distinguish.

sentences.zh: 口语优先，还有一场神秘会议
sentences.en: Speaking comes first, plus a mysterious meeting

sentences.zh: 史蒂文觉得这学期“一晃而过”。
sentences.en: Steven feels this semester "flew by in a flash."

sentences.zh: 学生出奇地配合，大概因为他的课件比去年条理清楚。
sentences.en: The students were surprisingly cooperative, probably because his course materials were better organized than last year's.

sentences.zh: 不过他自嘲，对考试评分标准，自己也只比学生“稍微明白一点点”。
sentences.en: But he joked at his own expense that, when it comes to the exam grading criteria, he understands only "a tiny bit more" than the students.

sentences.zh: 晚上七点他有个线上会议，多半是统一评分标准的事。
sentences.en: At 7 p.m. he has an online meeting, most likely about standardizing the grading criteria.

sentences.zh: 他最看重口语。
sentences.en: He values speaking the most.

sentences.zh: 今天他让大家走到教室另一头找新同伴聊天，可大家还是按性别抱成小圈子。
sentences.en: Today he had everyone walk to the other side of the classroom to find a new partner to chat with, but they still clustered into little groups by gender.

sentences.zh: 他认为口语考试对语法没那么苛刻，说错了能马上补救。
sentences.en: He thinks the speaking exam isn't as strict about grammar, since you can fix a mistake right away.

sentences.zh: 答疑时间与“雅思搭子”
sentences.en: Office Hours and "IELTS Buddies"

sentences.zh: 按合同，史蒂文每周上12节课，还要有6小时答疑时间。
sentences.en: Under his contract, Steven teaches 12 classes a week and also has to hold 6 hours of office hours.

sentences.zh: 他理解学生为什么不来：走过来、等候、谈二十分钟、再走回去，一小时就没了，而这“本可以开个视频会议解决”。
sentences.en: He understands why students don't come: walking over, waiting, talking for twenty minutes, then walking back, and an hour is gone, when it "could have been solved with a video call."

sentences.zh: 他的办法是“雅思搭子”：学生结伴来练雅思口语常见话题。
sentences.en: His solution is "IELTS buddies": students come in groups to practice common IELTS speaking topics.

sentences.zh: “你们练了口语，我也算完成了答疑时间。”
sentences.en: "You get to practice your speaking, and I get my office hours done."

sentences.zh: 雅思练习中的灵光一现
sentences.en: A Flash of Insight from IELTS Practice

sentences.zh: 有个学生想做一整套雅思口语模拟考。
sentences.en: A student wanted to do a full IELTS speaking mock exam.

sentences.zh: 问到第四题时，史蒂文承认自己“眼神都涣散了”，可这次练习却大有收获。
sentences.en: By the fourth question, Steven admitted his "eyes were glazing over," yet the session turned out to be very rewarding.

sentences.zh: 被问到最喜欢哪种广告时，她答不上来，因为她不相信广告，遇到广告就跳过。
sentences.en: When asked what kind of advertisement she liked best, she couldn't answer, because she doesn't trust ads and skips them whenever she sees them.

sentences.zh: “很好，就从这儿入手。”
sentences.en: "Great, let's start right there."

sentences.zh: 史蒂文说。
sentences.en: Steven said.

sentences.zh: 他告诉她，负面的回答只要礼貌地说出来，完全没问题。
sentences.en: He told her that a negative answer is perfectly fine, as long as it's said politely.

sentences.zh: 她在第二部分卡住时，他说：“没关系，说就是了。”
sentences.en: When she got stuck on Part 2, he said, "It's okay, just say something."

sentences.zh: 雅思考的是你会不会用这门语言，而不是你对话题懂多少。
sentences.en: IELTS tests whether you can use the language, not how much you know about the topic.

sentences.zh: 录下来，转成文字
sentences.en: Record it, turn it into text

sentences.zh: 史蒂文意识到练习时应该录音。
sentences.en: Steven realized he should record himself when practicing.

sentences.zh: 大多数学生的手机都能把语音转成文字。
sentences.en: Most students' phones can convert speech into text.

sentences.zh: 转写不会百分之百准确，但有了录音，学生就能回到卡壳的那一刻。
sentences.en: The transcription won't be 100% accurate, but with a recording, students can go back to the exact moment they got stuck.

sentences.zh: 与此同时，他的公寓“已经满屋蒜味”，他算好了时间，节目结束时牛排刚好出炉。
sentences.en: Meanwhile, his apartment "already smelled of garlic throughout," and he had timed it so the steak would come out just as the show ended.

sentences.zh: 读个中文学位？
sentences.en: Get a degree in Chinese?

sentences.zh: 一位同事在台北读过硕士，史蒂文受到启发，借助ChatGPT查了在线中文项目。
sentences.en: A colleague did a master's in Taipei, and inspired by that, Steven used ChatGPT to look up online Chinese programs.

sentences.zh: 台湾大学有硕士项目，但重点是“教”中文。
sentences.en: National Taiwan University has a master's program, but it focuses on teaching Chinese.

sentences.zh: 就他所知，大陆没有哪所大学提供这样的在线学位。
sentences.en: As far as he knows, no university in mainland China offers an online degree like this.

sentences.zh: HSK之于中文，就像雅思之于英语，但学位分量更重。
sentences.en: HSK is to Chinese what IELTS is to English, but a degree carries more weight.

sentences.zh: 他考虑读学位的理由有：
sentences.en: His reasons for considering a degree are:

sentences.zh: 获得更多认可，还能学书法、历史、语言学
sentences.en: More recognition, plus the chance to study calligraphy, history and linguistics

sentences.zh: 和女朋友的家人聊得更流利
sentences.en: Chatting more fluently with his girlfriend's family

sentences.zh: 学习有章法，不再“东拼西凑”
sentences.en: Structured learning instead of "piecing things together"

sentences.zh: 或许能去国外教中文，“比如沙特阿拉伯或津巴布韦”
sentences.en: Maybe teaching Chinese abroad, "say in Saudi Arabia or Zimbabwe"

sentences.zh: “拉丁语、希腊语、英语都有了，也该把中文加进去。”
sentences.en: "I've got Latin, Greek and English, so it's time to add Chinese."

sentences.zh: 他开玩笑说。
sentences.en: he joked.

sentences.zh: 真正的问题是：五千美元，他更愿意花在学位上，还是环游世界上？
sentences.en: The real question: would he rather spend five thousand dollars on a degree, or on traveling the world?

sentences.zh: 他还没拿定主意。
sentences.en: He hasn't made up his mind yet.

sentences.zh: 亚当·库里、《圣经》和美国教皇
sentences.en: Adam Curry, the Bible, and the American Pope

sentences.zh: 亚当·库里是几年前受洗的重生基督徒，本月底将离开《No Agenda》。
sentences.en: Adam Curry, a born-again Christian who was baptized a few years ago, will leave No Agenda at the end of this month.

sentences.zh: 他的搭档约翰·德沃夏克今年去世，让库里重新思考如何安排时间。
sentences.en: His co-host John C. Dvorak died this year, which led Curry to rethink how he spends his time.

sentences.zh: 他将专注于上帝和《圣经》，并帮小教区做播客。
sentences.en: He will focus on God and the Bible, and help small parishes make podcasts.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文的妈妈怀疑他不算称职的乌克兰天主教徒，他便边想边聊起宗教。
sentences.en: Steven's mom suspects he isn't a proper Ukrainian Catholic, so he talks about religion, thinking out loud.

sentences.zh: 中国很少谈宗教和政治，美国却把“我们信仰上帝”印在硬币上。
sentences.en: China rarely talks about religion and politics, yet America prints "In God We Trust" on its coins.

sentences.zh: “我不怀疑上帝的存在。”
sentences.en: "I don't doubt the existence of God."

sentences.zh: 他说，但对那些只信《圣经》的人持怀疑态度，因为《圣经》成书时离耶稣的时代已很久。
sentences.en: he says, but he's skeptical of people who believe only in the Bible, because it was written long after Jesus's time.

sentences.zh: 他会怀念《No Agenda》的媒体剖析，称之为“登峰造极”。
sentences.en: He'll miss No Agenda's media deconstruction, which he calls "the pinnacle."

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's Summary

sentences.zh: 无论是雅思答题，还是读学位这样的大决定，史蒂文的建议都一样：别再跟自己真实的想法较劲，把话说清楚，结构自然会跟上来。
sentences.en: Whether it's answering IELTS questions or a big decision like doing a degree, Steven's advice is the same: stop fighting your own real thoughts, say things clearly, and the structure will naturally follow.

vocab.en: to flash by; (time) to fly past
buddy, partner for a shared activity (slang)
